title: questlog history.jsonl event
description: One line of history.jsonl. Append-only audit log, never rewritten. This schema validates a SINGLE event object (one line). Frozen against Build Plan Section 1.5.

action.description: The tool name, or ui_note_add, ui_decision_approve, ui_unclear_set, ui_milestone_delete, ui_item_delete, ui_quest_delete, ui_dispatch, dispatch_done, dispatch_failed, file_edit, seed, conflict_held (a colliding write was held for a founder ruling — nothing was applied and nothing was discarded), conflict_ruled (the founder ruled; patch.keep says which version stands), conflict_void (the contested record was deleted, so there was nothing left to rule on).

patch.description: Optional: the fields that changed. Omit for large bodies if desired.

sessionId.description: OPTIONAL (Build Plan Section 1.3). The AI session that produced this event (a UUID is typical). Non-empty string, NO prefix rule. Absent = a pre-central event or an unattributed/founder action. Validator checks type + non-emptiness only.
